import importlib
import pathlib
import sys
import types
import unittest

import torch

SOURCE = pathlib.Path("/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE))
hyper = importlib.import_module("model.hyperbolic")
model_module = importlib.import_module("model.model")


class GeometryGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_squared_distance_matches_central_difference_and_gradcheck(self):
        # Away from the coincident-point clamp, compare autograd with an
        # independent central finite difference of the stated Poincare formula.
        x = torch.tensor([[0.12, -0.08]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.17, 0.21]], dtype=torch.double)
        value = hyper.squared_distance(x, y, c=1.0).sum()
        grad, = torch.autograd.grad(value, x)
        eps = 1e-6
        def oracle(xx):
            d2 = sum((float(xx[0, j]) - float(y[0, j])) ** 2 for j in range(2))
            x2 = sum(float(xx[0, j]) ** 2 for j in range(2))
            y2 = sum(float(y[0, j]) ** 2 for j in range(2))
            u = 2.0 * d2 / ((1.0 - x2) * (1.0 - y2))
            a = __import__('math').log1p(u + (u * (u + 2.0)) ** 0.5)
            return a * a
        for j in range(2):
            plus, minus = x.detach().clone(), x.detach().clone()
            plus[0, j] += eps
            minus[0, j] -= eps
            numeric = (oracle(plus) - oracle(minus)) / (2 * eps)
            self.assertAlmostEqual(float(grad[0, j]), numeric, delta=2e-6)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(lambda a: hyper.squared_distance(a, y, c=1.0), (x,), eps=1e-6, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-4))
        self.assertGreater(float(grad.norm()), 1e-5)

    def test_flat_limit_and_ball_projection_have_live_gradients(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.35, -0.22]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.1, 0.3]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        flat = hyper.squared_distance(x, y, c=0.0)
        expected = 4.0 * ((x - y) ** 2).sum(-1)
        torch.testing.assert_close(flat, expected)
        flat.sum().backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(x.grad)
        self.assertIsNotNone(y.grad)
        self.assertGreater(float(x.grad.norm()), 0.1)
        raw = torch.tensor([[1.2, 0.4]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        projected = hyper.project_ball(raw, radius=0.9)
        self.assertLessEqual(float(projected.norm()), 0.9000001)
        projected.square().sum().backward()
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(raw.grad).all())
        self.assertGreater(float(raw.grad.norm()), 0.1)

    def test_nonfinite_input_is_detected_not_silently_accepted(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[float('nan'), 0.1]], requires_grad=True)
        loss = hyper.squared_distance(x, torch.zeros_like(x)).sum()
        self.assertFalse(bool(torch.isfinite(loss)))
        loss.backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(x.grad)


class ObjectiveGradientTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _model(self):
        cfg = types.SimpleNamespace(hidden_sizes=[8], dropout=0.0, codebook_num=3,
                                    codebook_size=[256, 256, 256], codebook_dim=2,
                                    curvature=1.0, radius=0.9)
        torch.manual_seed(19)
        net = model_module.RQVAE(cfg, in_dim=4).double()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for code in net.rq.codebooks:
                code.normal_(mean=0.0, std=0.08)
        # Frozen targets are deliberately constants: they must not be an
        # alternate gradient route around the current encoder/codebooks.
        net.frozen_codes = torch.tensor([[3, 7, 11], [5, 9, 13]], dtype=torch.long)
        q = torch.full((2, 3, 256), 1.0 / 256, dtype=torch.double)
        net.frozen_transport = q
        return net

    def test_reconstruction_assignment_balance_and_transition_gradients(self):
        net = self._model()
        emb = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1, 0.3, 0.4], [-0.3, 0.25, 0.1, -0.2]], dtype=torch.double)
        r = torch.full((2, 256), 1.0 / 256, dtype=torch.double)
        total, rec, assign, _, transition = net(emb, edges=(emb, r))
        balance = net.population_balance(emb)
        for loss in (rec, assign, balance, transition):
            self.assertTrue(bool(torch.isfinite(loss)), msg=str(loss))
            self.assertTrue(loss.requires_grad)
        for name, loss in (("reconstruction", rec), ("assignment", assign),
                           ("global balance", balance), ("transition", transition)):
            net.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            loss.backward(retain_graph=True)
            enc_grad = [p.grad for p in net.encoder.parameters() if p.grad is not None]
            self.assertTrue(enc_grad, msg=name + " disconnected from encoder")
            self.assertGreater(sum(float(g.norm()) for g in enc_grad), 1e-9, msg=name + " zero encoder gradient")
            code_grad = net.rq.codebooks[2].grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(code_grad, msg=name + " disconnected from code vectors")
            self.assertTrue(bool(torch.isfinite(code_grad).all()), msg=name + " nonfinite code gradient")
            self.assertGreater(float(code_grad.norm()), 1e-10, msg=name + " zero code gradient")
        self.assertFalse(net.frozen_transport.requires_grad)
        self.assertFalse(net.frozen_codes.requires_grad)
        # A detached/disconnected surrogate must fail the same graph contract.
        disconnected = rec.detach()
        self.assertFalse(disconnected.requires_grad)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            torch.autograd.grad(disconnected, tuple(net.encoder.parameters()), allow_unused=False)

    def test_nan_objective_fails_finite_guard(self):
        net = self._model()
        emb = torch.tensor([[float('nan'), 0.0, 0.1, 0.2], [0.2, 0.1, -0.1, 0.3]], dtype=torch.double)
        total, *_ = net(emb)
        self.assertFalse(bool(torch.isfinite(total)), "NaN input must not yield an apparently valid finite objective")
